title: NodeBalancer has no active backends
description: Notifies when a NodeBalancer port has no healthy backends, which means clients on that port get errors.

definition.name: [Akamai Cloud Pulse] NodeBalancer {{entity_label.name}} port {{port.name}} has no active backends
definition.message:
NodeBalancer `{{entity_label.name}}` has no healthy backends on port `{{port.name}}`.

Check the backend nodes and the health check settings of this NodeBalancer config.
